title: Rust vector-mirror test for GCP-6.5 COSE_Sign1 slot claims (test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.json)
description: Child of l1qw.16.2 (GCP-6.5 Rust gateway slot-claim COSE_Sign1), INDEPENDENT of the decode-rewire child (.16.2.2): slot.rs RawSlotClaim::from_cose (slot.rs:516) and SlotClaimVerifier already implement the spec path, they just are not driven by the shared vector corpus. Acceptance (bead .16.2: 'Mirror the .16.1 vectors'): new rust/lichen-gateway/tests/gcp_slot_claim_vectors.rs following the groups_cbor_vectors.rs pattern (include_str!("../../../test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.json") + serde_json, dev-dep already present). Iterate document[cases]: hex decode cose_sign1_hex / signer_public_key_hex / signature_hex as needed; for expect_valid==true cases RawSlotClaim::from_cose(cose_sign1_hex, 64).unwrap() then assert decoded fields (slots from case[slots], superframe_epoch, mode, expiry, claim_seq, ordinal) and SlotClaimVerifier::new_ephemeral(64).verify(decoded, &pubkey, superframe_epoch).unwrap(); for reject cases assert the mapped error per expected_reject_reason: algorithm->SlotError::UnsupportedAlgorithm (from_cose decoy arm), kid_payload_mismatch->SlotError::IdentityMismatch (from_cose kid!=payload iid arm), signature->verifier error on valid-decode envelope, replay->verify same envelope twice, second errs Replay, expired/ordinal_missing->decode MalformedClaim or per-vector shape (check each case in the JSON first and mirror what Python slot_claim.py + python tests assert; do not invent semantics). If a vector case exercises behavior that is another bead's scope (e.g. expired handled in handler timing gate not from_cose), assert the actual implemented behavior and note it in a comment referencing the bead. cargo test -p lichen-gateway --test gcp_slot_claim_vectors must pass; the vector JSON is the oracle - never edit it.
